== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Nakothi]]'s song is a persistent and powerful auditory phenomenon associated with the [[Great Elder]] known as [[Nakothi]], also referred to as the [[Dead Mother]]. This [[resonance]] is closely linked to the [[Heart of Nakothi]] and can be heard even when the entity is deceased. The song serves as a medium for [[Nakothi]]'s will, which remains difficult for humans to resist. It manifests in various ways: as a constant undercurrent that can disturb sleep, a shrill and deafening crescendo during certain events, or as whispering voices that offer the listener new purposes or the chance to possess her power. The song is so potent that it can drive people insane and can be felt directly by those with Reader’s senses{{!}}Reader's senses. It is described as being very similar to the sound of the Heart itself.}}
